## How to test

- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes locally

## Scientific claims

- [ ] This change does not add a mechanism, a baseline, or a numeric potency or PK value
- [ ] If it does, every new mechanism or baseline has a DOI or PMID in `configs/evidence_registry.yaml`, and the benchmark note says which fields are published and which are a scenario timebase
- [ ] No EC50, Cmax, half-life, Tmax, onset, or other PK number was invented
- [ ] The change does not predict binding from structure, blood–brain barrier penetration, ADMET, toxicity, or clinical efficacy
- [ ] Readouts are still described as dimensionless proxies, not as clinical measurements or medical advice
